label: TEST ACCOUNT experiment: does the War Banner Change Team button cost tokens or reroll the banner?
account: the operator's TEST account. The target account was not used and did not change.
design: before/after on one client session, single variable (the Core team), nothing else touched

model_validation.note: The test account's nine emblems were also checked against banner_model and all nine reproduce exactly, on a banner set generated independently of the target account.
model_validation.includes: a Tier V emblem at +150 percent, the top of the quality ladder, not previously observed anywhere
examples: mid Runes 180% = 1 + 0.30 + (0.30 sole Unique + 0.20 adjacent Benevolent)
model_validation.running_total: 18 emblems across two accounts and three banner generations, plus two predictions made before the fact

supersedes: the assumption that any team change costs one roll token
the assumption that a team change might regenerate the banner, which had been sized at a -5360 expected loss and was blocking every switch
